title: feat(ai): cache assistance output for identical findings
problem: Repeated assistance requests for the same finding waste time and, with a provider, tokens.
why: Caching reduces cost and latency deterministically.
scope: Add a content-addressed cache keyed by fingerprint + provider + model, with a bounded size.
guidance: Store under the scan cache directory; never cache secrets.
tests: Unit tests for cache keys and eviction
security: Do not cache source content; cache only explanations.

title: test(ai): redaction tests for assistance output
problem: Assistance output must never contain secrets, environment variables, or absolute home paths.
why: Assistance is the most likely place for accidental data exposure.
scope: Add tests that feed findings containing secret-like strings and assert the output is redacted or rejects them.
guidance: Implement a redaction pass for common token patterns and home directories.
acceptance: Redaction tests pass for offline and provider paths
